parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Create an n8n Header Auth credential for the webhook.
2. Set header name `X-Portfolio-Token` and its value to the same `N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` configured in the Python backend.
3. Add an SMTP credential to the Email notification node.
4. Set n8n environment variables `PORTFOLIO_NOTIFY_FROM` and `PORTFOLIO_NOTIFY_EMAIL`.
5. Activate this workflow and put its production webhook URL in the matching backend environment variable.
